orders.text:
CRLR No.156 of 2018 
With 
CRMA No.987 of 2018 (Stay Application) 
Hon’ble V.K. Bist, J.
Mr. Pradeep Chamyal, Advocate 
for the revisionist. 
Mr. Sandeep Tondon, Deputy 
Advocate General for the State of 
Uttarakhand. 
Heard. 
Admit. 
Issue notices to the respondent 
nos.1 to 3, returnable at an early 
date. 
Summon the Lower court 
record. 
List this matter after service of 
notice upon the said respondents. 
Also heard on stay application. 
After considering the submission 
of the learned counsel for the parties 
and going through the material 
available on record, it is directed that 
the effect and operation of the 
judgment and order dated 27.4.2018 
passed by learned Judge, Family 
Court, Haridwar in Criminal Case 
No.136/2013, “Smt. Anita & others 
vs. Sher Singh”, under Section 125 of 
Cr.P.C., shall remain stayed provided 
revisionist pays Rs.5,000/- per 
month as maintenance to the 
respondent nos.1 to 3, on or before 
15th of every month. 
Stay application stands disposed 
of. 
 (V.K. Bist, J.) 
 29.5.2018 
A.kaur

Mediator for mediation.
List after Mediator’s report.
